sequence.cn: 字面意思是一种茶，但现在用来形容一种人。
sequence.py: Zìmiàn yìsi shì yì zhǒng chá, dàn xiànzài yòng lái xíngróng yì zhǒng rén.
sequence.en: Literally it's a kind of tea, but now it describes a kind of person.

sequence.cn: 表面上清纯善良，其实心机很重。
sequence.py: Biǎomiàn shàng qīngchún shànliáng, qíshí xīnjī hěn zhòng.
sequence.en: Sweet and innocent on the surface — but actually very calculating.

sequence.cn: 办公室新来了一个女生，叫小雅。
sequence.py: Bàngōngshì xīn láile yí gè nǚshēng, jiào Xiǎo Yǎ.
sequence.en: A new girl named Xiao Ya joined the office.

sequence.cn: 她总是轻声细语，对每个男同事说："这个我不会，你能教我吗？"
sequence.py: Tā zǒngshì qīngshēng-xìyǔ, duì měi gè nán tóngshì shuō: "Zhège wǒ bú huì, nǐ néng jiāo wǒ ma?"
sequence.en: She always speaks softly, telling every male coworker: "I can't do this, can you teach me?"

sequence.cn: 可是每次开会，她的方案总是最好的。
sequence.py: Kěshì měi cì kāihuì, tā de fāng'àn zǒngshì zuì hǎo de.
sequence.en: But every meeting, her proposal is always the best one.

sequence.cn: 年底她对老板说："我什么都不懂，全靠大家帮忙～"
sequence.py: Niándǐ tā duì lǎobǎn shuō: "Wǒ shénme dōu bù dǒng, quán kào dàjiā bāngmáng~"
sequence.en: At year-end she told the boss: "I don't understand anything, it's all thanks to everyone~"
The result? She's the one who got promoted.

sequence.cn: 所以说，绿茶不是不努力——而是一边努力，一边装作什么都不会。
sequence.py: Suǒyǐ shuō, lǜ chá bú shì bù nǔlì—— érshì yìbiān nǔlì, yìbiān zhuāngzuò shénme dōu bú huì.
sequence.en: So, a 绿茶 isn't lazy — she works hard while pretending she can't do anything.
